mapper.select: select sum(POSITION.ASSETVALUE_A) ASSETVALUE_A, sum(POSITION.ASSETVALUE_B) ASSETVALUE_B, POSITION.ASSETTYPE, ifnull(POSITION.INDUSTRY1,'NULL') INDUSTRY1, POSITION.IN_ASSET_TYPE, POSITION.PPPFLAG, POSITION.MONIT_TYPE, POSITION.MANAGE_TYPE, POSITION.IS_GOVERN_FUND1, POSITION.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG, POSITION.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG, POSITION.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG, POSITION.RATING,POSITION.ASSETTYPE2,ASSETINFO.ASSET_TYPE3, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_CAPITAL, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_PERPETUAL, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_PREFER from CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION POSITION LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSETINFO ON ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE = POSITION.ASSET_CODE and ASSETINFO.status in('E','M') where DATE_FORMAT(POSITION.ENDDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and DATE_FORMAT(POSITION.ENDDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by POSITION.ASSETTYPE, ifnull(POSITION.INDUSTRY1,'NULL'), POSITION.IN_ASSET_TYPE, POSITION.PPPFLAG, POSITION.MONIT_TYPE, POSITION.MANAGE_TYPE, POSITION.IS_GOVERN_FUND1, POSITION.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG, POSITION.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG, POSITION.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG, POSITION.RATING, POSITION.ASSETTYPE2,ASSETINFO.ASSET_TYPE3, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_CAPITAL, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_PERPETUAL, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_PREFER

SELECT SUM(cashflow) cashamt,CCY ccy,PROD_ID prodId FROM (SELECT SUM( CASE prdeal.TRADE_TYPE WHEN '03' THEN (ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0)+ifnull(prdeal.REDEMPTION_FEE,0)) * -1 WHEN '04' THEN 0 WHEN '05' THEN 0 WHEN '14' THEN 0 WHEN '15' THEN 0 WHEN '16' THEN ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0) * -1 WHEN '17' THEN (ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0)+ifnull(prdeal.REDEMPTION_FEE,0)) * -1 ELSE ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0) END) cashflow, prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_deal prdeal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=prdeal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' WHERE PAY_DATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND TRADE_TYPE NOT IN ('05','14','15') and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND PRDEAL.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM( CASE prdeal.TRADE_TYPE WHEN '04' THEN ifnull(prdeal.INT_AMT, 0) * -1 ELSE 0 END) cashflow, prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_deal prdeal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=prdeal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' WHERE INTEREST_DATE<=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND PRDEAL.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM(-1*ifnull(fee.AMT,0 ))cashflow, fee.CCY,fee.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_fee_deal fee left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=fee.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' WHERE fee.PAY_DATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND fee.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY fee.CCY,fee.PROD_ID ) base GROUP BY CCY,PROD_ID

SELECT sum( case when deal.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','03','05','08','10','12') then -1*ifnull(deal.AMT,0) else ifnull(deal.AMT,0) end ) cashamt ,DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.CHL_CPCT_ID is null and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.DEALDATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and deal.STATUS !='D' group by DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY

SELECT sum( case when deal.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','03','05','08','10','12') then -1*ifnull(deal.AMT,0) else ifnull(deal.AMT,0) end ) cashamt ,DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.trade_type !='02' and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.DEALDATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and deal.STATUS !='D' group by DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY

SELECT SUM(UNINVEST_CASH) CASHAMT FROM( select DISTINCT UNINVEST_CASH,PLAN_ASSET_ID from chb_bot_ast_pos where PLAN_ASSET_ID in (SELECT DISTINCT ASSET_CODE FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.trade_type='05'and deal.status !='D' and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03') and pos_date=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and status !='D') de

select cp.PROD_ID prodId,Round((cp.accuqty/aq.qty)*ap.UNINVEST_CASH,2) cashamt, AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID oldAssetCode,ci.ccy from chb_asset_position cp INNER join ( select DISTINCT UNINVEST_CASH,PLAN_ASSET_ID from chb_bot_ast_pos where PLAN_ASSET_ID in (SELECT DISTINCT ASSET_CODE FROM chb_asset_position deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.trade_type='05' and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.CDATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE}) and pos_date=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and status !='D' and UNINVEST_CASH !=0) ap on ap.PLAN_ASSET_ID=cp.ASSET_CODE left join (select sum(cp.accuqty) qty,cp.ASSET_CODE from chb_asset_position cp INNER join ap on ap.PLAN_ASSET_ID=cp.ASSET_CODE where cp.CDATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP by cp.ASSET_CODE) aq on aq.ASSET_CODE=cp.ASSET_CODE left join chb_asset_info ci on ci.ASSET_CODE=AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID and ci.status !='D' where cp.CDATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE}
